packageRules.description: Void framework packages release in lockstep (void, @void/react, @void/md share one version) — bump them in a single PR so a partial update can't half-upgrade the toolchain or conflict with a full bump.

Keep satori below 0.33. satori 0.33+ loads HarfBuzz wasm, which cannot start in Cloudflare Workers, so the /sponsors and /support-matrix images return 500. Remove this rule once satori renders in workerd again.
